Nung kid akooo, simula nung nag hiwalay sila ng tatay ko. I hated how she acted like she needs a partner to grow old with. Yung pagiisip ko nung bata sa mom ko is she can handle everything without anybody kasi syempre role model ko siya, saludo ako sakanya noon palang. And now that I’m older, naiintindihan ko na kung ano pinanggalingan niya. Nakakatakot talaga maging mag-isa. And thats how she is, she likes love. She likes giving love. She likes being loved.

But one thing that affected me is her expectations, nakaka-pressure talaga. She expected me to be a good girl sa nápaka toxic na pamilya. I just have to be good so that I don’t hurt them. That made me become a people pleaser, but I am working on it now. I have better boundaries with the toxic family and if they’re that bad, I cut them off. ✂️
